result.title: Distill Until Divergence: Error-Truncated Hindsight Distillation for Agentic RL
result.summary: Long-horizon interaction requires agents to make multiple decisions in a changing environment. Outcome-based GRPO lacks fine-grained guidance for intermediate decisions. Recent methods distill completed trajectories into reusable skills and use hindsight-conditioned OPD to provide dense token-level credit. However, skill-induced probability shifts do not necessarily represent reward-aligned credit; especially after an erroneous action changes subsequent interaction states, skill-conditioned supervision may become mismatched with the current state. To address this mismatch, we propose \methodname{}, which routes two complementary hindsight skills according to trajectory outcomes and error boundaries: Positive skills capture successful workflows to reinforce successful trajectories and pre-error decisions, while Negative skills capture failure-specific corrections to target decisive errors. The post-error suffix is optimized exclusively by GRPO, retaining outcome-based learning without extending potentially mismatched hindsight supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive task performance and support effective fine-grained credit allocation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对长时程 agent 中 GRPO 缺乏中间决策细粒度指导的问题，提出按轨迹结果与错误边界路由正、负两种 hindsight 技能进行蒸馏：正技能强化成功流程与出错前决策，负技能纠正决定性错误，而出错后的后缀仅由 GRPO 优化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「错误边界截断监督」与正负技能路由，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的贡献分配、监督范围与错误后状态处理提供可核查线索；但对象是纯文本 agent，不涉及视觉或 latent 推理状态，迁移性需人工判断。
